content_sections.heading: IIT Hyderabad Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details (Post-wise)
content_sections.text: There are a total of 2 vacancies available under the ICMR-funded project titled "AI-assisted 3D Vein Viewer: Portable NIR stereovision device using AI-based depth mapping to guide clinicians in safe, accurate IV access and jugular cannulation for challenging patients".

content_sections.heading: IIT Hyderabad Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Desirable Qualifications: For Project Technical Support-III, prior research/laboratory experience in instrumentation, biomedical device development, optics/imaging, electronics, embedded systems, CAD/3D printing, data analysis, or related areas will be preferred.

rows.qualification_required: M.Sc. in Physics/Biomedical Science or B.E./B.Tech. in Engineering, preferably in Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Biomedical Engineering, or related areas.

Three-year under graduate degree in Science, preferably with Physics specialization, or Diploma in Engineering, preferably in Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Biomedical Engineering, or related areas.

content_sections.text: The notification does not mention any application fee.

content_sections.heading: IIT Hyderabad Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates will be shortlisted based on academic record and relevant experience. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for the online interview. Meeting the eligibility criteria does not guarantee an interview call. The PI reserves the right not to fill the position if no suitable candidate is found.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Hyderabad Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Check the eligibility criteria for Project Technical Support-I or Project Technical Support-III. Access the application form link provided in the official notification. Fill in the Google form ( Application Form Link ) with the required details. Submit the completed application form on or before 17 October 2026. Ensure the application is complete, as incomplete applications will not be evaluated.

content_sections.heading: IIT Hyderabad Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The appointment is on a temporary basis for 11 months, starting as soon as possible. The appointment is extendable for another 3 years based on performance and availability of funding. Incomplete applications will not be evaluated. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for the online interview. For queries, candidates may write to Prof. Vandana Sharma (Email: [email protected] ), Department of Physics.

faq.question: Q1. What is IIT Hyderabad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: IIT Hyderabad has issued a recruitment notification for Project Technical Support-I (Non-Medical) and Project Technical Support-III (Non-Medical) posts for an ICMR-funded project.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in IIT Hyderabad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies, with one post each for Project Technical Support-I and Project Technical Support-III.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for IIT Hyderabad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to fill out the Google form application is 17 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for Project Technical Support-III?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc. in Physics/Biomedical Science or B.E./B.Tech. in Engineering, preferably in Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Biomedical Engineering, or related areas.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification required for Project Technical Support-I?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a three-year undergraduate degree in Science, preferably with Physics specialization, or a Diploma in Engineering, preferably in Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Biomedical Engineering, or related areas.
